properties.otherAdvice:
Vivid Sydney returns for its 15th year for 23 consecutive nights from Friday 23 May to Saturday 14 June and will be lighting up 5 key zones across the city.

The city is no place for cars with road closures and clearway parking restrictions in place each night in Circular Quay, The Rocks, Dawes Point, Millers Point and Ultimo between 3pm and midnight daily, and until 1am on Saturday nights.

Road closures:

  • Monday to Thursdays: from 3pm local roads in The Rocks, Millers Point and Dawes Point will close including sections of Lower Fort St, Merriman St and Rodens Ln. From 5pm additional roads will close including sections of George St, Argyle St, Harrington St, Pottinger St and Loftus St.
  • Fridays: additional closures will be in place from 3pm on High St, High Ln, Argyle Pl. From 5pm additional closures will be in place including all of Argyle St, and sections of Hickson Rd, George St, Essex St, Upper Fort St and Watson Rd. From 6pm roads in Circular Quay including Pitt, Loftus, Young, Albert and Phillip Streets will close as well as a section of Darling Dr in Ultimo. From 7pm lanes will close on Erskine St westbound and Kent St southbound.
  • Saturdays + Sun 8 Jun: local closures will be in place from 3pm, and mentioned key roads in Circular Quay, The Rocks, Millers Point, Dawes Point and Ultimo will close from 5pm. Additionally Grosvenor St/Bridge St between York St and Loftus St will be closed - no east/west access via Bridge St during this time. Roads remain closed until 1am on Saturdays. Wheat Rd will close from 7pm to 11pm.
  • Sundays + Mon 9 Jun: local closures will be in place from 3pm, and key roads in Circular Quay, The Rocks, Millers Point, Dawes Point and Ultimo will close from 5pm to midnight listed above.
  • 2pm Friday to 1am Monday: each weekend, George St will close between Lower Fort St and Hickson Rd for The Rocks markets. 

Special event clearways will be in effect on various roads between 3pm and midnight each day during Vivid Sydney on most major roads in the Sydney CBD, The Rocks, Circular Quay, Dawes Point and Haymarket. Some clearways will be in effect earlier from 1pm and 2pm on local roads.

Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types, and apply even to local residents and TfNSW Mobility Scheme Permit holders. Check signs carefully as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.

properties.otherAdvice:
Large crowds are expected to attend Primex at the Richmond Valley Events Centre from Thursday 15 May until Saturday 17 May, 9am to 4pm daily. 

Traffic is expected to be heavier than usual as crowds arrive and leave the event each day, particularly on Saturday. Motorists should allow extra travel time on Bruxner Hwy, Johnston, West and Centre Streets and local roads in the area. Be aware of increased traffic turning onto Cassino Drive throughout the event.

Central Coast Comicon will be held on Saturday 17 May from 10.30am to 4.30pm at The Entertainment Grounds. With up to 5000 people expected to attend, plan your trip. Free shuttle buses will run between Gosford train station and the venue (every 10 mins) between 9:30am and 5.30pm.

Freestyle Kings at Qudos Bank Arena. Show starts at 3pm and finishes at approx. 5pm.

Roads around Olympic Park will be very busy as attendees travel to and from the event. Motorists should allow plenty of extra travel time on roads approaching Olympic Park including the M4 Mwy, Homebush Bay Dr, Concord Rd, Lane Cove Rd, Parramatta Rd, Centenary Dr and Silverwater Rd.

Attendees who have to drive should pre-book parking ahead of time to secure a space. If you have pre-booked your parking, follow the directions of staff and have your parking ticket ready to show at the car park entry.

Sydney Olympic Park Authority may close some local roads to accommodate increased public transport services and ensure pedestrian safety during events. For road closure details, Check out the Sydney Olympic Park Authority interactive map for more details.

Attendees who need to drive should pre-book parking online ahead of time to secure a space, available until 11:59pm the night before the event unless sold out prior.

Road closures may be in place on Captain Cook Dr from approximately 10 minutes before kick-off and remain in place until crowds have cleared around 30 minutes after full-time.
